_meta.notes: 18-page duplex scan whose even pages are blank versos - PDF page 2 is blank, so the Summary Page is PDF page 3 (its own header reads 'Page 1 of 8', 'Date of Report Dec. 31, 2013'). A 2013 year-end filed on a stale form whose printed interim dates all read 2012; Year-End box checked, neither amendment box checked. Signature date 1/31/14, clerk stamp JAN 31 2014. Column B is headed 'Year to Date'. Line 3 is written '0.00' with a slashed/looped zero. Face arithmetic consistent.

contributions.detail: exact (10486.34 = 10486.34). 22 rows over 2 pages; both page subtotals gate exactly (8,286.34 + 2,200.00) and their sum equals the printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED and Summary Page line 1.

expenditures.detail: delta -0.14 (itemized 9325.14 vs stated 9,325.28). CAUSE IS THE FILER'S OWN PAGE ARITHMETIC, isolated to two pages: p13 rows 3,115.11 vs its printed subtotal 3,115.31 (-0.20) and p15 rows 1,336.33 vs its printed subtotal 1,336.27 (+0.06). The other three pages gate exactly. The filer's five PRINTED subtotals do sum to 9,325.28 exactly, so the stated total is internally consistent with the subtotals and inconsistent with the rows underneath two of them. Every amount on both offending pages was re-read at 600-700 dpi and read identically; nothing was adjusted.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: A p5: 15 rows = 8,286.34 = printed subtotal - PASSED. A p7: 7 rows = 2,200.00 = printed subtotal - PASSED (8,286.34+2,200.00 = 10,486.34 = printed TOTAL). B p9: 14 rows = 2,556.14 = printed subtotal - PASSED. B p11: 14 rows = 1,905.33 = printed subtotal - PASSED. B p13: 14 rows = 3,115.11 vs PRINTED SUBTOTAL 3,115.31 - WOULD NOT GATE, both figures named, rows unchanged. B p15: 14 rows = 1,336.33 vs PRINTED SUBTOTAL 1,336.27 - WOULD NOT GATE, both figures named, rows unchanged. B p17: 4 rows = 412.23 = printed subtotal - PASSED. Cross-check: the five printed B subtotals (2,556.14+1,905.33+3,115.31+1,336.27+412.23) sum to exactly 9,325.28, the printed TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE and Summary line 2 - so the filer's subtotal-to-total identity closes even though two of the subtotals do not match their own rows.
itemized.escalation_note: p13 amount+date columns in two 600 dpi band crops (all 14 rows) after the page missed its subtotal by $0.20 - every glyph re-read identically (360.62 not 360.82, 53.41 not 53.61). p15 amount+date columns in three 700 dpi band crops (all 14 rows plus the subtotal/total cells) after the page missed by $0.06 - 152.79 is unambiguously a 9, and the printed subtotal is unambiguously 1,336.27. Per the standing rule the arithmetic was consulted FIRST (the 5-subtotal-to-total identity is what proved p13's subtotal is 3,115.31 and not the 3,115.91 a low-res contact sheet suggested); resolution was then raised only on the cells no identity could constrain, and the identity was NOT used to overwrite a legible glyph.
itemized.notes: 18-PAGE PDF BUT ONLY 9 PAGES CARRY CONTENT: the scan is duplex and every EVEN page (2,4,6,8,10,12,14,16,18) is a blank white back (measured mean pixel 254 on each). Content: p1 cover, p3 Summary Page, p5+p7 Itemized Contributions Received, p9/p11/p13/p15/p17 Itemized Expenditures Made. The form's own handwritten page numbering runs '2 of 8' .. '8 of 8' and does not match the PDF page numbers; itemized_pages_* above use PDF page numbers. PRIVACY: the county redacted the Complete Mailing Address column on BOTH Schedule A pages with a solid black bar, so donor_city/donor_state are blank and 'redacted' is stated on every contribution row. The bar also swallows the tail of one long handwritten name (line 3, 'Coleman-Nicholl, Kristi...'), which is left incomplete. One contribution row (line 13, Andrews) has TWO stacked dates in the date cell and is therefore date-blank + needs_review. Handwriting convention: this filer writes the cents pair small and raised, so '.00' can look like '.06' or '.86' at 200 dpi - the page-subtotal identities resolve every one of them to .00 and that reading is what makes both Schedule A pages gate exactly. Cover: Jake Parkinson, Republican, Office Sought 'County Assessor', YEAR-END January 31 box checked, signed 1/31/14, stamped RECEIVED JAN 31 2014 - consistent with the chunk label.
